lines.text: Astra: tap a Continue Watching card and it plays the stream you last picked, from where you stopped. Hold it for others.
Astra now stays the same on every phone you sign in on: add-ons, library, progress and settings follow you.
Stream cards hide the long hash line and say before you tap when a stream will play poorly on this phone.
Films start sooner after a tap and hold less memory. Stream info has Copy playback report for a slow start.
